Name: AliveNpcs
Author: LUCASGATICA
Description:
[center][size=6][b]🌿 AliveNpcs[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]AI dialogue, memory, gossip and emergent stories for Stardew Valley[/b][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43475/43475-1783978143-732409181.png[/img]

Pelican Town, but alive. Villagers talk with you in their own voice, remember what you said and did, gossip about it, write you letters and turn your choices into stories that keep going across your save.

[size=5][b]📜 New in 1.7: Seen and Heard[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][b]They see what you do:[/b] gifts, drinks, bombs, trash cans, bedroom doors, proposals and more. Villagers remember it, feel something about it and may walk over to react on the spot.[/*]
[*][b]Group conversations:[/b] two villagers standing together can pull you into a three-way chat, and they answer each other too.[/*]
[*][b]Friends who care:[/b] villagers fish beside you and share their catch, and friends bring you food when you're hurt or exhausted.[/*]
[*][b]A farm computer full of apps:[/b] a real desktop with the Messenger, Pelicangram, Perfection, an aquarium and mini-games like Chicken Race and Junimo Typing.[/*]
[*][b]Everything got a new look:[/b] diary, letters, story arcs, gossip, the Character Sheet, and a settings menu of its own, with search.[/*]
[*][b]Nothing gets lost:[/b] when the AI fails, a Try again button saves your conversation, your diary and the day's gossip.[/*]
[*][b]7 festivals with AI dialogue:[/b] the Luau, the Moonlight Jellies, the Stardew Valley Fair, Spirit's Eve and the Festival of Ice join the Egg Festival and the Flower Dance. Villagers talk like they're really at the festival, and the town keeps talking about it for a couple of days.[/*]
[*][b]Also:[/b] scenes happen where villagers really are (no teleporting), an interaction wheel, and NVIDIA NIM as a new AI provider.[/*]
[/list][center]Seen and Heard got huge help from my friend [b]Xniffer[/b], who came up with the idea behind the triggers and built the first prototype of NPC awareness.

[size=4][b][url=https://lucasgatica.github.io/alivenpcs-site/changelog.html?v=1.7]Read the full 1.7 changelog[/url][/b][/size]
Every version explained in plain words, in English, Português and Español, on the [url=https://lucasgatica.github.io/alivenpcs-site/changelog.html]changelog page[/url].

[b][url=https://lucasgatica.github.io/alivenpcs-site/]Website[/url] · [url=https://discord.gg/8vUfXEH852]Discord[/url] · [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@lucasgaticadev]TikTok[/url] · [url=https://ko-fi.com/lucasgatica]Ko-fi[/url][/b][/center]

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]⚠️ You need an AI provider[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][b]Google Gemini:[/b] [url=https://aistudio.google.com/apikey]get an API key here[/url]. You can add up to 20 keys, and AliveNpcs switches to the next one when a key hits its limit.[/*]
[*][b]NVIDIA NIM:[/b] get free API keys at [url=https://build.nvidia.com]build.nvidia.com[/url]. You can add several keys too; create each one with a different NVIDIA account, since keys from the same account share limits.[/*]
[*][b]Any OpenAI-compatible server[/b], hosted or local. Local models need your own hardware, and you bring the model.[/*]
[/list]Replies usually take a few seconds. How good they are depends on the model you choose.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]✨ What it does[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][b]Real conversations:[/b] type whatever you want. Villagers answer in character and know your save: season, weather, hearts, gifts, heart events, marriage and what happened lately.[/*]
[*][b]They notice you:[/b] what you do near villagers becomes their memory. Do it again, or do something serious, and they come over to say something about it.[/*]
[*][b]Memory:[/b] they remember your talks and your gifts, how much they trust you and what hurt them. Their portrait follows their emotion.[/*]
[*][b]Gossip:[/b] what happens in public spreads through the village, one villager at a time. Tick [b]Keep secret[/b] to keep a talk private.[/*]
[*][b]Your diary and the village news:[/b] a diary tells the story of your playthrough, and a weekly paper sums up the village.[/*]
[*][b]A village with its own life:[/b] villagers have small moments with each other, form opinions and get into drama. Pick the intensity: Cozy, Balanced or Telenovela.[/*]
[*][b]Story arcs:[/b] patterns in your save become stories with objectives and choices, ending in a heart-event-style scene that becomes part of the village's lore.[/*]
[*][b]Letters, favors and outings:[/b] villagers send letters (sometimes with a gift), ask for favors that become real quests, and accept invitations to hang out.[/*]
[*][b]Dating and marriage in your own words:[/b] ask through dialogue. The bouquet and the Mermaid's Pendant still work.[/*]
[*][b]Festivals and everyday scenes:[/b] villagers talk about the festival they're at, in 7 of the game's festivals (plus 2 more with Beach Episode), and small scenes happen around the valley.[/*]
[*][b]Your character:[/b] fill out the Character Sheet so villagers know who you are and why you came.[/*]
[/list]Each villager's canon personality stays the foundation. The goal is a more reactive village, not random chaos.

[center][font=Courier New]F7[/font] Character Sheet · [font=Courier New]F8[/font] Gossip Diary · [font=Courier New]F9[/font] AliveNpcs Hub
New saves also get a farmhouse computer: a desktop with apps and mini-games, with pixel art by [b]@ChaseBlet[/b].[/center]

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🌐 Languages[/b][/size]
English · Português Brasileiro · Español · Français · Deutsch · Italiano · Tiếng Việt · 中文

Conversations follow the game's language. For a language the game doesn't have, set the language mode to [b]Custom[/b] in the mod settings and type the one you want.
Some new 1.7 settings texts still show in English in Español, Français, Deutsch, Italiano and 中文.
Trouble playing in your language? Tell me on Discord.[/center]

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]📦 Installation[/b][/size][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer (Stardew Valley 1.6+).[/*]
[*]Extract AliveNpcs into your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game and open the AliveNpcs settings: through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], or in game from the Hub ([font=Courier New]F9[/font]) → Quick Settings → All settings.[/*]
[*]Choose your AI provider and paste your key.[/*]
[*]Load a save and fill out the Character Sheet.[/*]
[/list]Updating from 1.6? Your settings keep the values you already chose.
Playing with friends? Also install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50946]AliveNpcs multiplayer mod[/url].

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🛡️ Safety and compatibility[/b][/size][/center]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Almost every system can be turned on or off. Adult relationship drama, infidelity arcs and expulsion arcs are off by default.[/*]
[*]Children and child-coded NPCs are always kept out of romantic and adult content. Your current spouse is never expelled, and canon marriages can be protected.[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded and other custom NPCs work, and you can turn AliveNpcs off for any NPC.[/*]
[*]Supports the [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki.gg/wiki/AI_Mod_Exclusion.json?action=raw]community AI opt-out list[/url], so NPC mod authors who don't want AI on their characters are respected.[/*]
[*]Seen and Heard doesn't need SpaceCore, and it leaves alone villagers controlled by other mods, such as Pelican Companions.[/*]
[*]Optional integrations: [b]Beach Episode[/b], [b]Personality Manager[/b] and [b]Experimental Content[/b] packs. Content packs can add their own Seen and Heard triggers with a single JSON file, and other mods can add apps to the farm computer.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] also install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50946]AliveNpcs multiplayer mod[/url].[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🐞 Found a bug?[/b][/size]
Send it on [url=https://discord.gg/8vUfXEH852]Discord[/url] with your SMAPI log, game language, AI provider and model, the NPC, the in-game date and what you typed.[/center]

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]💖 Support[/b][/size]
AliveNpcs and its updates are free for everyone. Donations are only a thank-you: they never unlock files, early access, features or support.
